sloka: एते वृक्षाः प्रकाशन्ते धूम संसक्त मस्तकाः ।मेघ जाल प्रतिच्छन्ना वैदूर्य गिरयो यथा ॥४-१३-२४॥
transliteration: ete vṛkṣāḥ prakāśante dhūma saṁsakta mastakāḥ ।megha jāla praticchannā vaidūrya girayo yathā ॥4-13-24॥

translations.english: 'These treetops covered with thick smoke glow like mountains of Vaidurya concealed by a cluster of clouds.
